answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The pulse is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the willow. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
